shots.name: k1
shots.prompt: Wide shot in a small neighbourhood library at the returns desk: Kerem, a young man of 24 in a grey hoodie with a backpack, hands a plain, titleless book across the wooden desk; Lena, a young woman of 22 in an olive-green cardigan and round glasses, takes it and looks up at him. Tall shelves with completely blank spines, warm afternoon window light. Vertical composition. Vertical composition.

shots.name: k2
shots.prompt: Use the reference image for the characters and the setting: keep the same faces, hair, clothes, colours and lighting. Medium shot across the desk: Kerem admits with a small shrug that he has nothing to read, one hand gesturing vaguely; Lena listens, the returned book still in her hands. Soft window light, blurred desk items. Vertical composition. Vertical composition.

shots.name: k3
shots.prompt: Use the reference image for the characters and the setting: keep the same faces, hair, clothes, colours and lighting. Close medium shot: Lena holds up a plain hardcover book, tapping its blank cover twice, and speaks with quiet confidence; Kerem tilts his head, intrigued. Warm library light, shallow depth of field. Vertical composition. Vertical composition.
